card.summary: H.R. 4346, known as the Preventing the Escalation of Armed Conflict in Europe Act of 2025 or the PEACE Act of 2025, aims to secure a peaceful resolution to the Russia-Ukraine conflict. The bill requires the Secretary of the Treasury to place strict financial sanctions and account prohibitions on foreign financial institutions that provide significant services to sanctioned Russian persons, entities, or entities operating in Russia's energy sector. It also mandates the seizure and transfer of specific Russian sovereign assets located in U.S. financial institutions to the Ukraine Support Fund.
